general_protocol: General Cross-Project Research Protocol v0.7.4 FINAL
purpose: Define provenance-complete SI-next relationship, uncertainty, lineage, local-versus-embedded, hierarchy, recovery, and multi-parent diagnostics without modifying or re-scoring physical results frozen under v0.2.

rules: The reporting slots do not assert that all three representations physically exist.
NOT_APPLICABLE is a valid explicit state and does not by itself make the relationship unresolved.
NONIDENTIFIABLE or NOT_MEASURED in an applicable view prevents resolved cross-view claims that require that view.
No system scalar may be generated by averaging or pooling lower-level scalar values.

uncertainty_U.rule: Every starting reporting slot has an explicit uncertainty state. NOT_APPLICABLE is valid only when the corresponding relationship view is also NOT_APPLICABLE. Precision in one applicable view cannot erase uncertainty in another applicable view.

rules: if system_scalar_reported is true, system_scalar_separately_derived_if_reported must be true

hierarchical_closure.rule: A disabled gate must use NOT_APPLICABLE. An enabled gate must state a nonempty higher-level question, validity regime, preservation targets, uncertainty/tolerance, and provenance-complete reference/reduced artifacts.

recovery_resilience.rule: When enabled, recovery/resilience is a separate output family and must use domain-native measures. Enabling does not authorize a universal resilience metric.

lineage.threshold_policy: No physical carrier-match cutoff is supplied by this contract.

multi_parent.normalization_policy: Source effects and interactions must not be normalized to sum to one or 100 percent.
multi_parent.exact_mobius_rule: Exact subset Mobius decomposition is admissible only when every one of the 2^n source subsets, including the empty subset and full set, has a provenance-complete response under one frozen protocol, with common units and response shape.
multi_parent.source_limit_role: computational complexity guard only, not a physical threshold

hard_refusals: cross-view master score requested or reported
lower-level scalar values averaged into a system scalar
system scalar reported without a separate derivation
Atlas information used to define or tune the coordinate or mapping
physical threshold introduced by SI-next ingestion
SI-next used to override a v0.2 physical label or score
post-target mapping or threshold fitting presented as prospective
lineage identifiability requested without uncertainty provenance
lineage relative flow interpreted as probability, causal fraction, inheritance percentage, system scalar, or promotion score
multi-parent source effects normalized to sum to one or 100 percent
incomplete 2^n subset manifest presented as exact Mobius decomposition
enabled hierarchical-closure gate without a declared higher-level question, validity regime, preservation target, reference, reduced object, or uncertainty/tolerance
disabled hierarchical-closure gate reported with a supported or failed closure status
asymptotic return conflated with finite-time resilience
